findings.title: load('sotus') returns a broken sklearn Pipeline instead of the documented SOTU speeches (Drive id duplicated with nips_model)
findings.repro:
env PYTHONPATH=/Users/jmanning/hypertools MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -c "
import hypertools as hyp
d = hyp.load('sotus')
print(type(d))          # <class 'sklearn.pipeline.Pipeline'>
print(repr(d))          # AttributeError
"
findings.expected: A collection of State of the Union speeches (text data, per the load() docstring), or at minimum an object of a data type (list/DataFrame/array)
findings.actual: type(d) == <class 'sklearn.pipeline.Pipeline'>; repr(d) raises: AttributeError: 'Pipeline' object has no attribute 'transform_input'. shasum: sotus == nips_model == 4f93308a48002730866659bda7ef393f5451dc8360b9e3c91c9cf5d77f73a762

findings.title: Hosted *_model pipelines are sklearn-1.0.2 pickles: InconsistentVersionWarning on load, repr()/display crashes with AttributeError under sklearn 1.8
findings.repro:
env PYTHONPATH=/Users/jmanning/hypertools MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -c "
import hypertools as hyp
m = hyp.load('wiki_model')   # InconsistentVersionWarning x3
print(m.transform(['the quick brown fox']).shape)  # (1, 50) -- works
print(repr(m))               # AttributeError
"
findings.expected: A model object that loads without version warnings and supports the standard sklearn surface (repr/get_params/clone/transform)
findings.actual: sklearn/base.py:463: InconsistentVersionWarning: Trying to unpickle estimator CountVectorizer from version 1.0.2 when using version 1.8.0 ... ; repr(m) -> AttributeError: 'Pipeline' object has no attribute 'transform_input'; m.transform() -> (1, 50) OK

findings.title: load() docstring dataset descriptions wrong: spiral type, mushrooms type + 'mushroomm' typo, weights_avg derivation, wiki structure undescribed
findings.repro:
env PYTHONPATH=/Users/jmanning/hypertools MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -c "
import hypertools as hyp
print(type(hyp.load('spiral')), len(hyp.load('spiral')))
print(type(hyp.load('mushrooms')), hyp.load('mushrooms').shape)
print([a.shape for a in hyp.load('weights_avg')], [a.shape for a in hyp.load('weights')][:1])
w = hyp.load('wiki'); print(type(w), len(w), w[0].shape, w[0].dtype)
"
findings.expected: Docstring descriptions match returned types/shapes: spiral 'list of two (1000, 3) arrays', mushrooms 'DataFrame', weights_avg description consistent with its (100, 100) arrays, wiki structure documented, 'mushroom' spelled correctly

findings.title: Hosted datasets nips, nips_model, and sotus_model are loadable but absent from the load() docstring's dataset list

env PYTHONPATH=/Users/jmanning/hypertools /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -c "
import hypertools as hyp
from hypertools.io.load import EXAMPLE_DATA
doc = hyp.load.__doc__
print([n for n in EXAMPLE_DATA if n not in doc])
"

findings.title: Non-string dataset arguments crash with cryptic low-level TypeErrors instead of a clear contract message
findings.expected: A hypertools-branded TypeError such as: 'dataset must be a string (dataset name, path, or URL) or a list of strings; got int'
findings.actual: TypeError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not int | ... not NoneType | ... not float | TypeError: argument should be a str or an os.PathLike object where __fspath__ returns a str, not 'bytes' | TypeError: unhashable type: 'dict'

findings.title: Invalid normalize= value surfaces as AssertionError (assert-based input validation) through load()
findings.repro:
env PYTHONPATH=/Users/jmanning/hypertools MPLBACKEND=Agg /Users/jmanning/hypertools/.venv/bin/python -c "
import hypertools as hyp
hyp.load('spiral', normalize='bogus')
"
findings.actual: AssertionError: scale_type must be across, within, row, none, or a fitted Normalizer.
